messages:
maya (People Ops): Heads-up — we have a visitor, Luca Moretti, arriving tomorrow 10:00am for a 30min demo. He asked about a taller chair / standing desk and said a small cake might be delivered to the lobby around 9:45. Can someone confirm seating + badge flow?
jamal: I can swap my hotdesk for a tall stool. where should the cake go if it arrives early? fridge? :cake:
olivia: badge printer's been flaky this week — it jammed this morning but front desk cleared it. @front-desk-bot can you confirm printer status before 9:30?
front-desk-bot: Printer status: OK (last restarted 2h ago). Visitor check-in form: https://intra.company/checkin?visitor=luca. Please have Luca's ID ready.
sara: If cake arrives early we can put it on the small table in breakroom A (near the fridge) — label it "guest only". I'll post a sticky so no one eats it by accident. :memo:
devin: I'll bring the tall stool from my desk and plant it by the standing bench. also bringing a small speaker for ambient vibes unless anyone objects. :guitar:
maya (People Ops): Thanks! Two quick asks: 1) can someone please print a temporary visitor badge (Luca Moretti) and leave it at the front desk by 9:45? 2) if the badge printer jams, please ping me and we'll use the printed label workaround.
jamal: @olivia do you want me to leave the stool in the corner by the standing bench? happy to set it up at 9:30.
olivia: yes please. and jamal — if you see the printer error pop up again, hit the small PIN reset on the back (works 90% of the time). If not, i'll run down.
front-desk-bot: Badge printer error log snippet:
```
ERR 09:14:12 PaperFeedException: path=/dev/usb/lp0
CMD restart-printer --force
```
(Manual pin reset performed at 09:18)
sara: sticky note made. i'll also reserve the couch near the lobby for extra seating — add a sign "Reserved for guest". :white_check_mark:
devin: also — rumor has it Luca plays guitar. if he brings it, house rule: no impromptu busking in the lounge unless marketed as "Office Concert". :laughing:
maya (People Ops): Haha noted. All set then. I'll print a backup paper badge and leave it on the clipboard at the front desk. Thanks team! :tada:
